name: critic P12 dialogue + P11 npc life - round 2 (harsh, real game, index.html)

steps.note: ROUND 2. Judged only in the running game. Ledger: P12 #1 FAIL, P12 #2 PASS, P11 #1 FAIL, P11 #2 FAIL. New: P12 #3, P11 #3.

P12 #3 (NEW, biggest gap) - repro of the buried talk camera (hit in 2 of 3 runs of this exact sequence). Talk in this order; when it fires, the fifth conversation renders as a solid dark void: mean luminance 43.9 over the frame above the box, 100 percent of pixels below luminance 55, while cameraOccluders(true).fading is EMPTY and talkShot() still reports onScreen:true.

steps.msg: P12 #3 - the Gudgeon conversation renders as a solid dark void (meanLum 43.9, darkfrac 1.00) with fading=[] and onScreen=true

steps.note: P12 #2 PASS - four talks deep on Dimity Rowe: every one returns said>=1 with real text. The third talk, which used to open an empty window, now says 'Who are they for?'

steps.eval: (async()=>{const s=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const out=[];for(let t=0;t<4;t++){await __DQ.talkTo('dimity');await s(700);const D=__DQ.state().dialogue;out.push({talk:t+1,said:D&&D.said,text:D&&D.full});for(let k=0;k<10&&__DQ.state().dialogue;k++){__DQ.press('confirm');await s(250);}await s(300);}return JSON.stringify(out);})()

steps.note: P11 #1 FAIL - Puddlewick control, hero never moves, 72s, x/z sampled directly rather than trusting the walked counter. Ten humans walk; Dot and Bel do not move one millimetre.

steps.eval: (async()=>{const s=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const ids=__DQ.npcs().map(n=>n.id);const rec={};for(const id of ids)rec[id]=[];for(let k=0;k<48;k++){for(const n of __DQ.npcs())rec[n.id].push([+n.x.toFixed(4),+n.z.toFixed(4),+n.facing.toFixed(1),n.mode,n.walked]);await s(1500);}const out={};for(const id of ids){const A=rec[id];let d=0;for(let i=1;i<A.length;i++)d+=Math.hypot(A[i][0]-A[i-1][0],A[i][1]-A[i-1][1]);out[id]={sampDist:+d.toFixed(3),distinctXZ:new Set(A.map(a=>a[0]+','+a[1])).size,distinctFacing:new Set(A.map(a=>a[2])).size,walkedDelta:+(A[A.length-1][4]-A[0][4]).toFixed(3)};}return JSON.stringify(out);})()

steps.msg: P11 #1 - dot and bel: sampDist 0.000, 1 distinct position, 1 distinct facing, walkedDelta 0.000 over 72 seconds, clip 'celebrate'. The tag game never happens.
